OKLAHOMA CITY ( KFOR ) — Oklahoma has the third-highest suicide rate in the nation among veterans. As of 2023, Oklahoma is home to almost 277,000 veterans, making them nearly 10% of our population. Statewide, veteran suicides are 61% higher than the national average, and sadly those numbers are continuing to rise. Today at the state capitol, mental health advocates spoke to lawmakers in an interim study in hopes of identifying the gaps in mental health care and devising a plan to improve services. sources.page_context: ice of Media Relations Share this story Facebook Twitter LinkedIn Reddit Telegram Tumblr WhatsApp Email Appears In General VA recently released the National Veteran Suicide Prevention Annual Report , which analyzes Veteran suicide from 2001 to 2023, the most recent year for which data is available. The report shows there were 6,398 suicides among Veterans in 2023, down from 6,442 in 2022. The average number of Veteran suicides per day fell slightly, to 17.5 in 2023 from 17.6 in 2022. Other key findings from the report include: 61% of Veterans who died by suicide in 2023 were not receiving VA health care in the last year of their life. The suicide rate per 100,000 Veterans rose for both male and female Veterans
